layer_stack_strongest_first.doc: Sensora bus digital twin: OpenUSD scene of ONE steady RANS CFD case and three neural surrogates' precomputed predictions. Scene organisation only; not a solver.
Sensora bus scene: cameras, materials, bindings, visibility, labels (look & feel only)
Sensora bus scene: virtual probe definitions (+ cached values written by the application)
Sensora bus scene: cabin zones (driver / front / middle / rear) derived from CFD patch landmarks
Sensora bus scene: result sources, availability, the `source` variantSet with payloads
Sensora bus scene: where results are sampled: 3D preview point set (ids, positions), slice planes
Sensora bus scene: the single steady CFD case: metadata and boundary conditions on patch prims
Sensora bus scene: ILLUSTRATIVE exterior shell (presentation only): reference to assets/exterior_illustrative.usdc + alignment transform
Sensora bus scene: boundary patches as reconstructed display meshes / point sets, identities

stage.frame: X rearward along the bus, Y lateral (doors at Y>0), Z up; metres; origin front-bottom
stage.web_frame: identical to the CFD frame (Z up); see web/js/frame.js

geometry.representation: CFD patches: reconstructed_display_mesh (display only; not the solver mesh or CAD); /World/Bus/Exterior: illustrative_exterior (not CAD, not in the CFD domain)

labels.label: Driver
labels.rule: top of the face centres of Human_TaiXe_skin

labels.label: Front door
labels.rule: bbox centre of the face centres of door_front

labels.label: Middle door
labels.rule: bbox centre of the face centres of door_middle

labels.label: Rear
labels.rule: centroid of the face centres of window_rear

labels.label: Air vents
labels.rule: centroid of the face centres of inlet_supply_right

pi.label: PI-PN-DeepONet (continuity + BC informed)
pi.physics_scope: data loss + compressible continuity + wall no-slip, return-velocity, inlet-T and leak-p boundary terms; RANS momentum and energy NOT included

probes.label: Near the driver's head
probes.method: nearest exported CFD sample; valid only if Interior and <= 0.15 m away; no interpolation

probes.label: Front aisle, seated head height
probes.method: nearest exported CFD sample; valid only if Interior and <= 0.15 m away; no interpolation

probes.label: By the middle door, 1.1 m high
probes.method: nearest exported CFD sample; valid only if Interior and <= 0.15 m away; no interpolation

probes.label: Next to the rear seated passenger
probes.method: nearest exported CFD sample; valid only if Interior and <= 0.15 m away; no interpolation

defs.label: Driver area
defs.rule: cabin front to the end of the driver_area partition; includes the front entrance

defs.label: Front
defs.rule: from the driver area to the start of the middle door

defs.label: Middle
defs.rule: the span of the middle door

defs.label: Rear
defs.rule: behind the middle door to the rear wall (raised rear floor)

provenance.weighting: voxel-weighted: one Interior CFD cell per 8 cm voxel (the web 3D preview sample); approximates volume weighting because CFD cell volumes were not exported
provenance.box_rule: lo <= p < hi on every axis (hi inclusive at the cabin's far end); Interior samples only
provenance.values: read from each source's USD payload in source precision; nothing is interpolated
provenance.note: descriptive statistics only; not a comfort score, health indicator or validated KPI

exterior.source: procedural illustrative shell (no exterior CAD available); src/sensora_bus/usd/exterior.py

alignment.method: generated in the CFD frame from cabin landmarks; transform = identity, no scaling
landmarks: floor levels (floor) -> low-floor bus, ground assumed at z = 0
